facts.heading: Marriage ended after fifteen years
facts.content: Jana's marriage lasted for fifteen years.
facts.evidence: After fifteen years of marriage, my husband Radko and I decided on a divorce

facts.heading: Divorce decision made in September
facts.content: Radko told Jana in September that the marriage couldn't continue.
facts.evidence: in September he told me that it couldn't go on like this

facts.heading: Jana's emotional reaction to divorce
facts.content: Jana experiences feelings of emptiness and anger several times a day.
facts.evidence: Emptiness, then anger, then emptiness again. It happens several times a day.

facts.heading: Husband's reason for divorce
facts.content: Radko stated that the couple drifted apart and lived next to each other.
facts.evidence: He says that we drifted apart, that we live next to each other.

facts.heading: Jana questions her role in divorce
facts.content: Jana feels she should have noticed the signs of the relationship ending.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I was blind.

facts.heading: Jana's uncertainty about fault
facts.content: Jana wonders if she was too tired or if she cared too much.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I think I was too tired, I didn't care about him.

facts.heading: Children's ages and names
facts.content: Jana has two children: Anička, who is 12, and Matěj, who is 8.
facts.evidence: I have two children, Anička is 12 and Matěj is 8

facts.heading: Decision to tell children pending
facts.content: Jana and Radko have not told the children about the divorce yet.
facts.evidence: No. Radek wants us to tell them together, or we postpone it.

facts.heading: Anička suspects fighting
facts.content: Anička asked Jana if her father and Jana were fighting last week.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if Dad and I are fighting.

facts.heading: Jana lied to Anička
facts.content: Jana lied to Anička about the fighting, and Anička found out.
facts.evidence: Because I lied. And she found out.

facts.heading: Jana fears ruining daughter's life
facts.content: Jana felt she would ruin Anička's life by telling her the truth.
facts.evidence: That I would ruin her life.

facts.heading: Jana fears daughter's tears
facts.content: Jana is afraid of Anička's tears regarding the divorce.
facts.evidence: but I am afraid of her tears.

facts.heading: Housing situation details
facts.content: The house is on a mortgage, and Radko is likely moving in with his brother.
facts.evidence: The house is on a mortgage, Radek is probably moving in with his brother, at least for now.

facts.heading: Child will stay with Jana
facts.content: The child will remain with Jana.
facts.evidence: The child will stay with me.

facts.heading: Jana fears managing alone
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will not be able to manage the situation alone.
facts.evidence: I am afraid I won't manage it alone.

facts.heading: Job as Czech teacher in Brno
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher in an elementary school in Brno. She teaches nine-year-olds and eight-year-olds.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher in an elementary school in Brno. I teach nine-year-olds and eight-year-olds.

facts.heading: Feeling of life falling apart
facts.content: Jana feels that everyone sees her life is falling apart when she goes to class.
facts.evidence: I have the feeling that everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Principal knows about situation
facts.content: Only the principal at the school knows about Jana's situation.
facts.evidence: Only the principal. I told her because I once cried in the hallway.

facts.heading: Principal allowed early leave
facts.content: The principal let Jana leave early when she cried in the hallway.
facts.evidence: That she let me leave early.

facts.heading: Worse when alone at home
facts.content: Jana felt worse when she was alone at home after leaving work early.
facts.evidence: But then I sat at home and it was worse.

facts.heading: Sleep waking at 3 AM
facts.content: Jana wakes up at three in the morning every night.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at three in the morning

facts.heading: Worries about future
facts.content: When waking up at 3 AM, Jana thinks about what will happen next.
facts.evidence: and think about what will happen next.

facts.heading: Feelings of lacking stability
facts.content: Jana thinks she does not have a mortgage, a husband, or anything when she wakes up.
facts.evidence: That I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a husband, I don't have anything.

facts.heading: Sleep pattern details
facts.content: Jana falls asleep around five and wakes up at half past seven.
facts.evidence: I fall asleep around five and wake up at half past seven.

facts.heading: Weight loss and appearance
facts.content: Jana has lost four kilos and a friend told her she looks terrible.
facts.evidence: I've lost four kilos. A friend tells me I look terrible.

facts.heading: Support system includes sister
facts.content: Jana has her sister Alana in Olomouc who calls her almost every evening.
facts.evidence: I have my sister Alana in Olomouc. She calls me almost every evening.

facts.heading: Support system includes friend
facts.content: Jana has a friend Eva from work.
facts.evidence: And a friend Eva from work.

facts.heading: Fear of being judged by Eva
facts.content: Jana is afraid Eva might think she lied or that a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That I lied. That a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Belief from mother about marriage
facts.content: Jana believes her mom always said that marriage holds together and children want what they want.
facts.evidence: She always said that marriage holds together and children want what they want.

facts.heading: Mother's reaction to Jana
facts.content: Jana's mom was silent after Jana told her something, then said she hopes Jana thought about it well.
facts.evidence: She was silent. Then she said that she hopes I thought about it well.

facts.heading: Need for mother's approval
facts.content: Jana feels she would need her mom to approve of her.
facts.evidence: I would need her to approve of me.

facts.heading: Difficulty expressing needs
facts.content: Jana feels it hurts that she doesn't want to be alone, but this is not done in her family.
facts.evidence: That it hurts that I don't want to be alone, but that's not done in our family.

facts.heading: Crying when expressing feelings
facts.content: When Jana says her feelings out loud, she cries and apologizes.
facts.evidence: I cry and apologize.

facts.heading: Goals for improvement
facts.content: Jana wants to improve her sleeping and knowing how to tell the children.
facts.evidence: Sleeping and knowing how to tell the children.

facts.heading: Sleep aids tried
facts.content: Jana has tried chamomile tea for sleep.
facts.evidence: Chamomile tea and that's it

facts.heading: Refusal of medication
facts.content: Jana does not want to take pills prescribed by the doctor.
facts.evidence: I don't want them

facts.heading: Fear of addiction
facts.content: Jana is afraid of becoming addicted to medication.
facts.evidence: I don't want to be addicted

facts.heading: Fear of missing children
facts.content: Jana is afraid of not waking up in time for her children.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't be able to wake up in time for the children

facts.heading: Willingness to write down fears
facts.content: Jana stated she could write down her fears on paper.
facts.evidence: I could, but at least I get it out of my head

facts.heading: Fear of panic crying
facts.content: Jana is afraid of crying with panic and not staying calm.
facts.evidence: That I'll cry with panic, that I won't be able to stay calm

facts.heading: Concern for children's reaction
facts.content: Jana is worried about her children seeing her cry.
facts.evidence: That I would cry in front of the children?

facts.heading: Anička is sensitive
facts.content: Jana mentioned that Anička is sensitive.
facts.evidence: Anička is sensitive

facts.heading: Test today's theme
facts.content: Jana's focus today was on not being alone and not having to manage things immediately.
facts.evidence: That I am not alone and that I don't have to manage it right away
